result.brief: 提出 Slot-JEPA，将稠密 patch 表征分解为稳定语义槽与随时间变化的空间掩码，形成可复用的物体结构化预测接口，并用非平衡最优传输监督掩码预测与规划评估。
result.reason: Proposes Slot-JEPA, an object-structured latent world model with slot/mask decomposition and UOT-based mask supervision, directly contributing to JEPA-style representation learning and latent world models.
